status: frozen before opening any external expression matrix

S_D.rule: LRT q<0.05 and |coef_D|>=1 (DOG1 main effect at A=0, B=0)

S_D_robust.rule: S_D plus |DB_given_A0|<1 (dog1 effect similar in both ABA backgrounds)

S_maturity.rule: Col-0 round 2, 12-24 DAP (n=20). CPM>=1 in >=3 samples; Spearman rho with day >=0.8 (up) or <=-0.8 (down) and |log2 CPM(24d)-log2 CPM(12d)| >=2; top 500 per direction by |rho|*|delta|.

V1_rules.data: GSE251921 processed counts; Col-0 GSM7989996-7989999 vs dog1-4 GSM7990000-7990003
V1_rules.model: NB GLM, two group means, poscounts size factors, CR dispersion + EB shrinkage
V1_rules.primary: sign concordance and Spearman/Slope of V1 effect vs main coef_D on S_D; sample-level signature score (mean z of S_D genes, sign from main coef_D) compared between Col-0 and dog1-4
V1_rules.gate: if <50% of S_D genes map and pass the filter, report insufficient coverage
V1_rules.mapping: uppercase, strip version suffix, TAIR AGI IDs only

V2_rules.data: GSE5634 series matrix (MAS5 values as deposited); GSM131694-131708, stages 6-10, 3 arrays each
V2_rules.platform: GPL198 ATH1; probe->gene by GPL198 annotation; multiple probes: keep highest mean expression
V2_rules.primary: maturity score = mean z(up) - mean z(down) per array; Spearman with ordinal stage 6-10 and stage means reported; MAS5 values used as deposited, no second log
V2_rules.gate: if <50% of signature genes map to GPL198, report insufficient coverage
